data_description.region: The TTLock cloud your account and developer app are registered with. EU / International covers everywhere except mainland China.

webhook.title: Register your TTLock webhook URL
webhook.description:
TTLock won't push updates until this webhook URL is registered with your developer application:

`{webhook_url}`

Open the [TTLock console]({console_url}) and paste it in as the callback URL, then submit. See [the setup docs]({docs_url}) for more. You can revisit this URL later from the integration's Configure screen. Until this is registered, locks still stay in sync via the integration's regular poll.

init.title: Polling and Bluetooth
init.description:
How often the integration polls the TTLock cloud, and whether it also reads locks over Bluetooth. Locks update in near real time via webhooks, so the intervals can stay high to keep multi-lock accounts under TTLock's free-tier API-call limit. Lower the poll interval if your webhooks are unreliable.

TTLock webhook URL for this account:

`{webhook_url}`

data_description.poll_interval: How often to re-check whether each lock is locked or unlocked, in minutes.
data_description.slow_poll_interval: How often to refresh slow-changing detail (battery, name, autolock and passage-mode config, gateway signal), in hours.
data_description.bluetooth_enabled: Read lock state directly from a lock in range of Home Assistant, instead of asking the TTLock cloud. Turn this off to use the cloud only.

no_webhook_url.description: An error ocurred while trying to generate a webhook url. Please make sure that you have a URL configured in Settings > System > Network.
no_webhook_url.title: Unable to generate webhook URL.

webhook_registration_failed.description: The integration could not set up webhook updates. Locks continue to update through regular polling. Reload the integration to try webhook setup again.
webhook_registration_failed.title: Unable to set up TTLock webhook updates

webhook_consolidation_ambiguous.title: Confirm your TTLock webhook URL

webhook_setup.description:
TTLock won't push updates until this webhook URL is registered with your developer application:

`{webhook_url}`

Use the link below to open the TTLock console, or see [the setup docs]({docs_url}) for more info. You can also view this URL at any time from the integration's Configure screen. Until this is done, locks still stay in sync via the integration's regular poll.

shared_lock_no_remote_unlock.message: This lock is shared with you and the owner has not enabled remote unlock for your ekey. Ask the owner to turn on 'Remote unlock' for your ekey, or operate the lock with the TTLock app at the door.

shared_lock_admin_only.message: This action is only available to the lock's owner. The following locks are shared with you and cannot be managed from here: {entities}.

shared_lock_frozen.message: The owner has frozen your ekey for this lock. Ask the owner to unfreeze it in the TTLock app before you can use remote unlock again.

shared_lock_expired.message: Your ekey for this lock has expired. Ask the owner to extend or re-send the ekey if you still need access.

shared_lock_not_yet_valid.message: Your ekey for this lock is not valid yet. It becomes active at its configured start time - the owner can see the exact time in the TTLock app.
